title: Ephemeral events sent as MLS PublicMessage
description: SPEC l.1463, 2549 send ephemeral events as PublicMessage application data. RFC 9420 requires application data to be PrivateMessage. Fix: require PrivateMessage for all application data, including ephemeral events. Line numbers refer to import/ files (notes/research-2026-10-16.md).
close_reason: Fixed in be91134 (phase B); verified in text 2026-10-16
